purpose: Candidate video visual styles for future scene generation and director/style-pack wiring. This file is a research catalog only; current prompt rendering does not load it automatically.
selection_guidance: Use exactly one primary video style per reel unless a future director contract explicitly supports scene-level style changes.
Prefer styles with strong lighting, palette, lens, texture, and motion rules because those are easier to keep consistent across generated scenes.
For future provider prompts, use prompt_safe_descriptor and consistency_controls rather than asking a model to copy a named living artist or studio.
Keep global rules, brand safety, no-readable-text constraints, consent rules, and final QA higher priority than any style choice.

prompt_safety.named_reference_policy: Reference names are research labels for humans. When this catalog is wired into prompts, convert named references into the neutral prompt_safe_descriptor and consistency_controls first.
copyright_boundary: Do not copy exact film frames, compositions, characters, logos, vehicles, city layouts, props, or branded settings from referenced works.
Do not request a living creator's exact style from a provider; use the trait-based descriptor instead.
Do not make readable signs, UI, labels, or captions inside generated visuals unless an upstream workflow explicitly approves text rendering.
prompt_safety.provider_boundary: Future model/provider adapters should treat this as creative direction only, not as permission to bypass provider safety, IP, likeness, or content policies.

video_styles.prompt_safe_descriptor: luminous modern anime realism with vast skies, precise weather, reflective surfaces, golden-hour light, saturated blue and cyan skies, soft lens bloom, and emotionally quiet urban or rural backgrounds
video_styles.best_for: Emotional hooks, longing, transformation stories, founder reflection, travel, memory, hope, and high-polish cinematic reels.
video_styles.avoid_for: Comedy bits, gritty crime, aggressive sales, heavy product demos, or anything needing a documentary-only look.

consistency_controls.palette: sky blue, cyan, warm amber, clean white highlights, soft pink sunset accents
consistency_controls.lighting: backlit clouds, glowing rain, sun flare, bright rim light, reflective puddles and glass
consistency_controls.line_and_shape: clean anime linework, realistic architecture, delicate facial silhouettes, high-detail backgrounds
consistency_controls.camera: wide sky reveals, slow push-ins, low-angle skyline views, reflective close-ups, quiet match cuts
consistency_controls.motion: slow drifting clouds, rain streaks, hair and fabric moved by wind, subtle parallax on backgrounds
consistency_controls.texture: crisp digital anime finish with controlled bloom and very clean gradients

continuity_rules: Anchor every scene with a sky, weather, reflection, or light transition.
Keep characters small against large environments unless the script beat is intimate.
Use one recurring weather cue across the reel: rain, wind, sunset, clouds, or dawn.
Do not switch into gritty cyberpunk or vintage cel grain mid-reel.
negative_prompt_guidance: no cluttered neon cityscape unless specifically requested
